extraction.Name: George Colhoff
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat. Recorded June 18, 1923, by Security Savings Bank; Recorded Jan. 25, 1923
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to State Bank of Scenic for $2000.00 on December 6, 1922; SW4 26-37-39 deeded to Enla B. Snodgrass of Interior, So. Dak. by George Colhoff and Louisa Colhoff, his wife, on Aug. 18, 1925 for $1.00 and other valuable considerations
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jan. 15, 1920. Taken from the records at the County Seat. Mortgage on SW4 26-37-39 (including the NW4) to State Bank of Scenic, So. Dak. for $2000.00. Conveyance of SW4 26-37-39 recorded Aug. 19, 1925. Wife named Louise/Louisa Colhoff.
